meta.tagline: Islamic sciences and the Arabic language
meta.defaultDescription: Institut Talib Alim teaches the Islamic sciences and the Arabic language, on site in Montereau-Fault-Yonne and by video conference.

hero.title: Courses in the Islamic sciences and the Arabic language
hero.body: Religious education is a cornerstone in building a community that is aware, balanced and attached to its spiritual values.

featured.title: Popular courses
featured.body: Institut Talib Alim is a centre devoted to teaching the Islamic sciences, with programmes offered both on site and remotely.
featured.body2: We guide our students through the sciences of creed, fiqh, the Qur’an and the history of Islam, with teaching that is accessible, progressive and faithful to Islamic values.

how.title: Three steps, then you study
how.step1Body: A few seconds and an email address, and you can already browse the whole catalogue and read the trial lessons.
how.step2Body: One membership opens every course, including those published after you join. Online, or by paying at the institute.
how.step3Body: Video and written lessons, live classes, replays, quizzes and marked assignments — on site as well as by video conference.

approach.title: Thorough, balanced teaching
approach.point1Body: Teaching delivered by skilled, experienced instructors.
approach.point2Body: Courses available on site and remotely.
approach.point3Body: Structured teaching, grounded in the authentic sources.

why.title: Why choose us?
why.body: Courses taught by qualified instructors, combining religious knowledge, clear pedagogy and attentive support for solid, step-by-step learning.
why.reason1Body: Programmes are offered on site and by video conference, so students can carry on with their studies wherever they live.
why.reason2Body: The teaching material is organised progressively and rests on the authentic sources as well as on the study of the recognised schools of law.
why.reason3Body: The aim is to develop both theoretical understanding and practice, within an educational setting built on ethics, rigour and respect for Islamic values.

pricing.noAutoRenewBody: Enrolment lasts 365 days and stops at the end of that term. No card is kept on file, and nothing is charged without your agreement.
pricing.faq1Q: Does enrolment renew on its own?
pricing.faq1A: No. It lasts 365 days and then expires. Renewing is a deliberate purchase on your part.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens if I renew before the end of the term?
pricing.faq2A: The new 365 days are added to the time you have left. You never lose days by renewing early.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I pay at the institute?
pricing.faq3A: Yes. The institute takes the cash and hands you a single-use code. You enter it at checkout, the total drops to zero, and access opens exactly as it would with an online payment.
pricing.faq4Q: What is the difference between the two cursus?
pricing.faq4A: The Cursus Module is à la carte: you pick the subjects that interest you, for a year. The Cursus Approfondi is a programme built across several years, followed in order, for study in depth.
pricing.faq5Q: Can I move from on site to video conference?
pricing.faq5A: Each mode has its own programme and its own price, and your enrolment is for the one you chose. Write to us and we will look at it case by case.

admin.gateBrokenTitle: This account has no profile row
admin.gateBrokenBody: The account exists in authentication but has no row in the profiles table. That happens when the account was created before the schema was applied, so the signup trigger never ran for it. Until that row exists, no role can be given to it.
